posts.en:
dsh-explorer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8a2ee177836663ccc3e7.html
